name: Second opinion
description: Ask OpenClaw and Hermes the same thing, each with only its own notes, and NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL weighs the two answers and says which to go with. Needs OpenClaw and Hermes running, and NEBIUS_API_KEY.
example: Should I take a job offer in Pune at 20% more pay, or stay in Bengaluru?
